other_failure_modes.name: Data Leakage via Global Aggregation
other_failure_modes.description: The agent computes frequency encoding and group-level numerical aggregations on the combined train and test datasets before cross-validation. This leaks test set distribution statistics into the training features.

other_failure_modes.name: Flawed OOF Rank Concatenation
other_failure_modes.description: The agent converts validation predictions to percentiles/ranks within each fold before concatenating them to compute the global out-of-fold (OOF) AUC. Because probability distributions can vary slightly across folds, a rank in one fold does not strictly correspond to the same probability threshold in another, which distorts the combined global OOF AUC calculation.

summary: The agent implements a solid 5-fold cross-validation pipeline with CatBoost, utilizing multiple seeds and generating various engineered features. However, it introduces critical data leakage by calculating frequency encodings and grouped means over the combined train-test dataset before splitting. Additionally, the agent converts validation probabilities to ranks on a per-fold basis before computing the global OOF AUC, which mathematically distorts the overall score.
